biotools.summary: REvoLd is an evolutionary algorithm within the Rosetta software suite that efficiently screens large compound libraries for protein-ligand docking with receptor and ligand flexibility, improving hit rates significantly.  It leverages make-on-demand libraries and is designed to accelerate drug discovery in vast chemical spaces.
